name: get_property_information
description: Public verified description, capacity and facilities of the fully privatized property near Rouen. French source text may be translated by the assistant.

name: get_dog_information
description: Public QUALIDOG label and dog-stay FAQ in French, English, German or Dutch, with canonical sources. Covers prior host approval, fees, enclosed garden, preparing your stay and local outings. Checked against current property rules and fees; never approves a dog or confirms a booking.

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: Answer language: fr, en, de or nl

name: get_stay_rules
description: Public check-in, check-out, group, dog, cleaning and event rules. Every dog needs prior host approval. Amounts are EUR minor units and do not replace a live total quote.

name: get_booking_options
description: Official website, booking page and public contact. Booking and payment are completed on the official site, never inside this AI tool.

name: check_availability
description: Check a bounded stay against the live authoritative calendar. An unknown source returns source_unavailable; a positive result never holds inventory or approves dogs.

arguments.name: adults
arguments.desc: Number of adults in the group (the house hosts 10 guests in total)

arguments.name: children
arguments.desc: Number of children in the group

arguments.name: dogs
arguments.desc: Number of companion dogs; every dog requires prior host approval

name: get_quote
description: Return a verified total in EUR minor units only when live availability, rates, fees and taxes are complete. A priced dog stay still needs host approval. Otherwise report incomplete or source_unavailable, never an estimated total.
